controlling_authority: Prince William Board of County Supervisors
source_license: Public — official government data. Verify terms of use with Prince William County before commercial redistribution.
pilot_notes: Live-verified 2026-08-13 via three rounds of disposable diagnostic GitHub Actions dispatch: Prince William County publishes real zoning district polygon geometry directly on its own ArcGIS Server (gisweb.pwcva.gov, Planning/Zoning/MapServer layer 5 'Zoning Districts', 2,227 features, field ZoningDistrict). The same MapServer also has a real 'Overlay District Data Center Opportunity Zone' layer (layer 7, a single designated rezoning case) not yet wired into this pipeline. Unlike Loudoun, this pilot ships with zero districts.json content -- district codes returned by the live geometry (e.g. via zoning_code on the normalized geometry) are real but have not yet been cross-referenced against the actual PWC Zoning Ordinance text for data-center permitted-use status. Do not treat an absent or 'not_listed' classification as meaning data centers are prohibited -- it means the classification has not been researched yet.
known_limitations: districts.json does not exist for this jurisdiction yet -- every real zoning code returned by the live geometry will show as unclassified until permitted-use research is done against the actual ordinance.
The Planning/Zoning/MapServer layer 5 'Zoning Districts' has no separate district-name field -- ZoningDistrict is the only classification attribute (no human-readable name comes from the source).
layer 7 'Overlay District Data Center Opportunity Zone' (a real designated rezoning case relevant to data-center siting) has been found but is not yet wired into the pipeline as an overlay layer.

Parcel-level zoning_code is not published by Prince William's parcel service (see js/parcel/registry.js's notProvidedBySource for FIPS 51153) -- connecting a parcel to this geometry requires a parcel-to-zoning spatial join, which does not exist in this codebase yet (planned, not yet built).
notes: Second Virginia pilot jurisdiction after Loudoun. Geometry pipeline proven end-to-end; permitted-use classification research is the next step, not yet done.
